newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu started visit to the Prague. Romania and the Czech Republic see integration into NATO structures as cooperative venture, not as competition, the radio quoted Czech President Vaclav Havel as saying after his meeting with Constantinescu.
* Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will visit Hungary starting March 12.

The partenership between Romania and Hungary forms the basis of stability in the region and will be one of the main arguments in favour of the two countries' joining NATO structures, Ciorbea said in interview with Hungarian news agency MTI.

* Ciorbea has asked the Chamber of Deputies to delay a vote on planned changes to the land reform law, to allow the government to harmonise it with reform promises made in exchange for credits from international lenders.
